title: Hash Embedding Mirror importance codes
hypothesis: For token labels recoverable from two hashed shared components, replacing two learned Hash Embedding importance values per token with one Mirror Givens angle preserves held-out-token classification NLL within 0.02 accuracy points of native Hash Embeddings, beats a one-scalar importance control by at least 0.05 accuracy, and reduces actual inference payload bytes by at least 15%; collision-degree performance should degrade less than unweighted hashing.
physical_object: shared pool of 64 learned 16-dimensional component embeddings and a shared linear classifier
mirror_coordinate: one learned angle per token mixing its two fixed hashed component vectors with cosine and sine coefficients
logical_multiplicity: 1024 token embeddings from a shared component table and one token-specific Mirror coordinate each
prior_art_delta: PA58 Hash Embeddings combine a few shared hashed component vectors with token-specific learned importance weights; the Mirror code replaces that importance vector with a structured coordinate.

model.labels: seeded balanced random class per token; all methods use the same fixed token labels per world
model.hashing: two fixed deterministic uint8 component indices per token, identical across methods within a world; indexes and metadata are charged

controls: independent full token embedding table upper control
native Hash Embeddings: shared component pool plus two learned token importance weights
same hash sum with no importance coefficients
same hash pool plus one learned scalar token gain on the component sum
Mirror: same hash pool plus one per-token Givens angle mixing the two selected vectors
development_gate_before_fresh: For both development seeds: Mirror test accuracy within 0.02 of native Hash Embeddings; Mirror >=0.05 above scalar importance; actual serialized inference payload <=0.85x native Hash Embeddings; and Mirror collision-degree accuracy no more than 0.05 below native in any populated degree bin. Otherwise fresh remains sealed.
success_gate: All three fresh worlds meet the quality/bytes/collision gates, with exact loaded-payload replay. Report NLL, accuracy, actual full payload bytes, token-level collision bins, train/inference compute and throughput.
failure_gate: Any registered development gate fails in either seed; fresh stays unopened.

storage.authority: actual deterministic ZIP/NPY FP16 model inference payload bytes after reload

boundaries: synthetic token-to-class lexical surrogate, not language-model or natural vocabulary evidence
same task labels and hash assignments for all controls within each world
collision degree is determined by full two-index tuple and fixed before evaluation
logical token count does not imply independent capacity
fresh seeds unopened until all development gates pass
